capabilities: Render Markdown notes with 30+ themes and style widgets
Process local images, GIFs, SVGs, embeds and image backgrounds
Render LaTeX, AsciiMath, Mermaid and Excalidraw content
Copy formatted articles or send WeChat MP drafts
Batch publish notes and convert notes to images
disambiguation: Not a note-to-MP3 audio converter; MP refers to WeChat Official Account publishing.
extras: Some features are member-only; expert settings can cause rendering errors if misconfigured; batch publishing accepts up to 8 notes; some multi-platform publishing needs other tools or browser extensions.
intentEvidence: 还在用微信公众号自带的编辑器写文章吗？
motivation: The author wanted writing and publishing to be one natural process, so notes stay ordinary Markdown files and users avoid spending time on formatting or buying templates.
problem: WeChat Official Account editing requires manual formatting and paid templates, and platform-specific markup can make notes incomplete outside the tool.
